glossary.note: 钢铁雄心4 术语对照表。翻译时严格遵守，保证全站译名一致。

style.register: 游戏指南体，简体中文，简洁直陈，不用敬语，不用『您』。
style.numbers: 数字、百分比、游戏内数值原样保留（如 10%、+5%）。
style.placeholders: ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧ 等占位符必须原样保留且不得增删、不得调换顺序；它们代表图标或链接。
style.markup: 不要输出 HTML 标签；保留原文的换行与项目符号结构。
style.properNouns: 国家、人物、舰名等专有名词使用通用中文译名（如 German Reich → 德意志国，Adolf Hitler → 阿道夫·希特勒）；Paradox 未汉化的专有名词可保留英文并加中文注释。
style.consistency: 同一英文术语在全站必须使用同一译名。

instructions: Translate every "en" string into Simplified Chinese (zh-Hans), game-guide register. Follow glossary.json strictly. Keep ⟦0⟧-style placeholders, numbers, units and wiki markup exactly. Return only {"items":[{"k":"...","zh":"..."}]} with the same k values.

units.en: The Career profile page shows statistics, non-steam achievements and various customizations. The visibility for other can be set to visible for other players, for only friends or private.
This page tracks overall statistics of all games the player has played. Sections of the page will be unlocked depending on the DLC the player has enabled.

The awards page gives the player alternative, in game achievements and goals outside the steam ⟦0⟧. The awards are available without ironman mode. Unlocking them allows customization of the top section of the career profile page.
Successfully defend against a certain number of enemy attacks.
Have a division reach a certain defensive bonus total.
Have a division reach a certain planning percentage bonus.
Destroy a certain number of divisions that suffer from the "Encircled" combat modifier
Surround a certain number of enemy divisions on one province.
Fight a battle with a certain number of positive modifiers affecting the battle.
While at war, deploy a certain number of military divisions within a 48-hour window. Minimum division size: 5 battalions.
Establish at least 75% Naval Supremacy in a certain number of contested sea regions.
Have an army consist of a certain number of veteran divisions.
Have transport planes provide a certain amount supply to a region.
Execute a paradrop battleplan using a certain number of paratrooper divisions. Minimum division size: 5 battalions.
Within 96 hours, execute naval invasion plans using a certain number of divisions. Minimum division size: 5 battalions.
Through land battles, gain (and hold) a certain number of additional provinces within a 48-hour window.
Shoot down a certain number of planes within a 48-hour window.
Build a certain number of new Civilian or Military Factories
Design a tank with a certain Armor Rating value and deploy at least 1000 of them in the field.
Design a plane with a certain Air Defense value and deploy at least a full air-wing of them (100 planes).
Gain over 50% naval supremacy from mines in a certain number of sea zones.
Decipher a certain number of ciphers.
Embargo a certain number of Nations
Have a battle continue without interruption for a certain number of days.
Gain at least one province every week for a certain number of weeks.
Have an advantageous casualty-ratio after having inflicted at least 1 million enemy causalties
While decrypting one cipher, have a "Capture Cipher" operation result in more than a certain amount of days removed from its decryption.
"If you find yourself in a fair fight, you didn't plan your mission properly." -Colonel David Hackworth
Over the course of 2 years, engage in twice as many offensive battles as defensive battles, with a minimum of 100 battles.
"There are three kinds of people: Those who are immovable, those who are moveable, and those who move them." -Attributed to Benjamin Franklin
Successfully attack and control an area with a Level 10 fort in it.
"When you go home tell them of us and say, for their tomorrow, we gave our today." -John Maxwell Edmonds
"Hitherto man had to live with the idea of death as an individual; from now onward mankind will have to live with the idea of its death as a species." -Arthur Koestler
Detonate 3 atomic bombs within a 12-hour window between detonations.
"It is easier to find men who will volunteer to die, than to find those who are willing to endure pain with patience." -Julius Caesar
Have at least 15 concurrent battles supported by a railway gun bombardment.
"It takes 15,000 casualties to train a major general" -Ferdinand Foch
Have a commander (excluding division commanders) increase their skill four times.
"They sowed the wind, and now they are going to reap the whirlwind." -The Bible, Hosea 8th, Verse 7
Execute a paradrop plan using 15 paratrooper division.

Execute 4 simultaneous naval invasions for 4 different landing zones.
"When the local language is violence, be fluent." -Unknown
"...the men who quell the storm and ride the thunder." -Teddy Roosevelt
We Shall Fight in the Shade

Have 20 aces use the same airport as their home base.

Deploy a division containing at least one battalion of "Anti-Air", "Artillery", "Rocket Artillery" and "Anti-Tank", supported by a signal company.

Deploy one hundred cavalry or camelry battalions.

Have no single or set of people depicted to be in charge of your nation.
